description: A pink bowl sits on the counter in front of you, with a yellow cup, a white LEGO-like block, a green die, and a couple of tools nearby. The left hand stays resting on the left side while the right hand reaches toward the white block, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and moves it leftward over the bowl, then lowers it into the bowl and releases it so it rests inside.
